elements.label: AI Agent Builder app window (with its contents)

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Before the window starts growing; one of the recurring percussive streaks of the bed.

pattern.description: The framed AI Agent Builder window (header, procedure form, canvas, cursor) scales up as one unit over a static dark green background, decelerating into its final larger size.
pattern.why_premium: Enlarging the product window itself instead of cutting gives the viewer a smooth 'lean in' to the procedure text just as narration says 'you just describe your business procedures', while the static backdrop keeps it from reading as a camera move.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(appWindow, {scale: 0.82, transformOrigin: '50% 50%'}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out'}); background untouched.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 100}}), [0, 1], [0.82, 1]) on the window container (no overshoot); background layer static.

notes: camera.move is none: scale 1.2173 is the window growing inside a static background, so no camera move is reported. The procedure textarea ends with a partial line 'Fina', suggesting typing continues; no candidate box covers it and it may fall outside this burst, so it is not listed. ui_camera_push_in is the nearest canonical pattern if a reviewer prefers it.
